title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Acts 20: the night at Troas and Eutychus, and Paul's farewell to the elders at Miletus.

questions.text: Why did Paul determine to return through Macedonia?
questions.explanation: A plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria, so he determined to return through Macedonia.

answers.text: A plot was made against him as he was about to sail for Syria
A vision in the night told him to turn back
A famine had come upon the whole of Greece
The elders at Ephesus had sent for him

questions.text: What happened to the young man named Eutychus as Paul spoke still longer?
questions.explanation: Weighed down with deep sleep while Paul spoke still longer, he fell down from the third floor and was taken up dead.

answers.text: He was healed of a long illness that night
He fell from the window but caught himself
He fell from the third floor and was taken up dead
He slept through the whole of Paul's speech

questions.text: What did Paul say when he went down and fell upon him?
questions.explanation: Embracing him, Paul said, "Don't be troubled, for his life is in him."

answers.text: Rise up and walk, in the name of the Lord
Don't be troubled, for his life is in him
He is not dead, but only sleeping
The Lord has taken him from among us

questions.text: Why had Paul determined to sail past Ephesus?
questions.explanation: He was hastening to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost, if it were possible, and did not want to spend time in Asia.

answers.text: A plot against him was waiting in that city
The elders there had asked him not to come
A storm had risen along that coast
He was hastening to be in Jerusalem on the day of Pentecost

questions.text: Whom did Paul call to himself when he sent from Miletus to Ephesus?
questions.explanation: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

answers.text: Timothy and Erastus
The disciples who were at Troas
The elders of the assembly
The brothers from Beroea

questions.text: How did Paul say he had served the Lord among them?
questions.explanation: He served the Lord with all humility, with many tears, and with trials which happened to him by the plots of the Jews.

answers.text: With all humility, with many tears, and with trials
With signs and wonders only, as the apostles did
With great power and authority over the assembly
By keeping the law of Moses blamelessly

questions.text: What did the Holy Spirit testify to Paul in every city?
questions.explanation: The Holy Spirit testified in every city that bonds and afflictions were waiting for him.

answers.text: That he would preach in Rome as well
That he would never return to Asia
That a great famine was coming
That bonds and afflictions were waiting for him

questions.text: What did Paul warn would happen after his departure?
questions.explanation: He said vicious wolves would enter in among them, not sparing the flock, and that men from among themselves would arise speaking perverse things.

answers.text: A great famine would come upon all the region of Asia
Vicious wolves would come in, and men among them would speak perverse things
The temple at Jerusalem would be destroyed by fire
The whole city would rise up against them in an uproar

questions.text: Which words of the Lord Jesus did Paul tell them to remember?
questions.explanation: He told them to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, "It is more blessed to give than to receive."

answers.text: It is more blessed to give than to receive
Freely you received, so freely give
The laborer is worthy of his food
Don't be afraid, only believe

questions.text: What did the elders do when Paul had finished speaking and knelt down to pray?
questions.explanation: They all wept freely, fell on Paul's neck and kissed him, sorrowing most of all because he had said they would see his face no more.

answers.text: They begged him to stay with them at Miletus a while
They went up with him as far as Jerusalem to the feast
They wept, kissed him, and sorrowed that they would see his face no more
They gave him silver and gold for the journey ahead
